rationale: The pain is real and specific — Salesforce ISV developers do face a genuine gap in established server-side file validation patterns for Apex — but the market is extremely thin. Only a few hundred active AppExchange ISVs build guest-user file-upload endpoints, single-signal discovery, near-zero community discussion volume, and no observable willingness-to-pay signal beyond inferred consultant costs. The evidence base does not meet the five-distinct-pain-quotes bar required for a pass verdict.
